items.text: **An exception and an interface owe *Help*** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`, `rule:core-api/reference-card`. `errors::TREE` (`crates/nvs-hir/src/errors.rs:96`) and `interfaces::RESERVED` (`crates/nvs-hir/src/interfaces.rs:44`) are bare tuples with no card. Give each row one `short` sentence, written in the end-user voice. Emit it as `doc.short` in `exception_json` and `interface_json` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs:212`, `crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs:230`), the way `enum_doc_json` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs:521`) does. Print it in `push_roster_card` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:796`). Interfaces are not on the `agent` index at all yet, so add them there too. Add a test in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/meta.rs` beside `every_enum_and_constant_carries_a_doc_key`. Then set `help: true` for both kinds at `tools/nv/proofs/collect.ts:45`. `roster.ts:296` already reads `doc.short` for both.

**A directive owes *Help*** — `rule:tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code`. `roster.ts` hard-codes `help: ""` for a directive (`tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:323`), so switching it on proves nothing. Make the help owed when the directive's key has no entry on the index that `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent/names.rs` builds. Emit what the roster needs from `directive_json` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs:239`). Then set `help: true` at `tools/nv/proofs/collect.ts:49`, and rewrite the comment above `POLICY` at `tools/nv/proofs/collect.ts:40`.

**Close the goal** — after both items, `bun nv proofs --gate` must still print all three wanted lines (`tools/nv/cmd/proofs.ts:249`). Then run AGENTS-loop step 6's `DONE` gates: `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-class-cards`, `bun nv playbook --closes core-class-cards`.
